ArtifactReference.description:
Immutable, checksummed reference to a stored artefact.

The reference is self-describing: it states the logical URI, the media type,
the size, the SHA-256 of the bytes and the artefact version, so that a reader
can detect substitution or truncation without trusting the writer.

EvidenceReference.description:
Reference from a card field to an element of the evidence ledger.

``quote``, ``page`` and ``section_path`` are optional *denormalized read fields*
for human review.  When present they must be byte-identical to the referenced
ledger record; the package-level validator enforces that, so they can never
drift into a second, competing source of truth.

ResolutionStatus.description:
Outcome of deterministic resolution (does the quote have a trustworthy location?).

``resolved``
    Exactly one location was found and verified.
``ambiguous``
    The quote text matches at more than one location (or the span/context check
    cannot single one out).  The resolver must **not** pick one at random and must
    not report a fabricated position as certain.
``unresolved``
    No exact (or acceptably normalized) match was found.  A fuzzy similarity is
    reported through :class:`MatchType` and never upgrades this status.
ResolutionStatus.title: ResolutionStatus

RetrievalStrategy.description:

receives, the strategy says how the fragments were found.
